title: Logo Strip
description: A trusted-by row of customer logos, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Skeleton primitives: a short muted heading over a grid of monochrome logos, each a mark and a wordmark that links to the customer's story, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — three logos per row at @sm, larger marks at @md, and all six on one row with more room above and below at @lg.
